Administrators use necessary Supabase authentication cookies, including session cookies with names beginning sb- and temporary PKCE verification cookies for account recovery and email confirmation. When payment is enabled, reviewing checkout sets the necessary first-party seen_checkout_owner cookie for up to 30 days. It is a random browser ownership token, contains no contact or card details, uses HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax, and is Secure on HTTPS. It authorises private order access after returning from Stripe. Blocking or clearing it prevents access to those orders in that browser. Stripe-hosted Checkout uses its own payment and fraud-prevention technologies; no Stripe script is loaded by this storefront. Clearing your bag does not cancel a pending checkout or remove this cookie.

You can also inspect or remove this site's cookies and local storage in your browser's site-data settings. Blocking necessary storage can prevent your bag from being remembered between visits. This button does not clear third-party cookies or unrelated browser data.

How SEEN ABAYAS handles shopping bags, checkout, order information, enquiries and website security.

Information supports the shopping bag and checkout you request, payment verification, order handling and related emails when those features are enabled, responses to your enquiries and protection of the site against abuse. Ordering or sending a contact message does not automatically subscribe you to marketing.

Please avoid sending payment card details or unnecessary sensitive information. If you choose not to supply a required form field, the form cannot send your enquiry; you can still browse the collection or email us.

Private order records and email-delivery records have no automated retention schedule configured in the application; the business must confirm appropriate retention arrangements. Your saved bag remains in local browser storage until removed or cleared by you or your browser. Inbox abuse-prevention receipts use server-keyed hashes of the email address and, on Vercel, the platform-provided network address. The raw network address is not stored in those receipts. Receipts older than 24 hours are pruned on the next accepted message; messages themselves remain until deleted by an authorised administrator. Inbox delivery stores verified enquiries privately in Supabase for customer care. Contact email delivery can optionally copy provider-accepted enquiries to the same inbox. Authorised administrators can read, archive and delete those messages; the business must confirm its enquiry retention period before launch.

How to measure for an abaya, understand length labels and ask the SEEN team for design-specific sizing advice.
Lay a well-fitting abaya flat, smooth out the fabric and use a flexible measuring tape. Keep the tape straight without stretching the garment.

Length and body fit are different measurements. If you are between lengths, or need more room through the chest or sleeves, share the design and your measurements with our team so we can help you compare.
Measure from the highest point of the shoulder beside the neckline down to the hem. Consider the shoes you intend to wear.
Measure from the shoulder seam to the cuff. Dropped shoulders and different sleeve shapes can change how this measurement is taken.
Measure straight across the garment from underarm to underarm. Double this flat measurement when comparing it with a full chest circumference.
Measurement positions are illustrative. Refer to each design for its actual fit.
